.test-btn .qx-btn{
transition: all 0.35s!important
}
.test-btn .qx-btn{
  position: relative
}
.test-btn .qx-btn:before,
.test-btn .qx-btn:after{
  position:absolute;
  content: "";
}
.test-btn .qx-btn:before,
.test-btn .qx-btn:after {
  width: 0%; height: 0%;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: width 0.2s 0.15s linear, height 0.15s linear, opacity 0s 0.35s;
}
.test-btn .qx-btn:before {
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
}
.test-btn .qx-btn:after {
  bottom: 0; left: 0;
}
.test-btn .qx-btn:hover:before,
.test-btn .qx-btn:hover:after {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  opacity: 1;
  transition: width 0.2s linear, height 0.15s 0.2s linear, opacity 0s;   
}
.test-btn .qx-btn:first-child:before {
    background-color: #000000;
}
.test-btn .qx-btn:nth-child(2):before {
    background-color: #1953FF;
}
.test-btn .qx-btn span{
    position: relative;
}
